items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Mr. Louise was on there, which is Vernon's wife now, but she was waking for me.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. So when they would pay off, I'd always get paid when I'd go on a boat. When they had an intermission to go get paid because I'd pay Callie up. Mr. Louise was on there, which is Vernon's wife now, but she was waking for me. And I'd always get my envelope there, and I'd go up there to Callie up. Well, old guy, he was watching, and he never saw me get my envelope, you know. And he…
I remember him. Huh? Floyd Casey. Floyd Casey. That's right.
